Marking of controls and instruments

Switches used to control power to ME EQUIPMENT, including mains switches, shall have their 'on' and 'off' positions marked with symbols IEC 60417-5007 and IEC 60417-5008, or indicated by an adjacent indicator light, or indicated by other unambiguous means

Switches used to control power to parts of ME EQUIPMENT shall have their 'on' and 'off' positions marked with symbols or with IEC 60417-5264 and IEC 60417-5265, or indicated by an adjacent indicator light, or indicated by other unambiguous means
A switch that brings the ME EQUIPMENT into the 'stand-by' condition may be indicated by use of symbol IEC 60417-5009 (2015-03) (see Table D.1, Symbol 29)

If a push button with bistable positions is used: it shall be marked with symbol IEC 60417-5010 (2002-10); and the status shall be indicated by an adjacent indicator light, or the status shall be indicated by other unambiguous means
If a push button with momentary on position is used: it shall be marked with symbol 60417-5011 (2002-10); or the status shall be indicated by an adjacent indicator light

products.name: PT9L
products.notes: No lithium batteries or fuel cells used; No protective earth terminal; No functional earth terminal; No terminals for supply conductors

semantic_fragments.content: The PT9L device does not use lithium batteries or fuel cells, has no protective earth terminal, no functional earth terminal, no terminals for supply conductors, and no fuses/replaceable thermal cut-outs/over-current releases accessible by tool. As a result, all related clauses in IEC 60601-1 (7.3.3 through 7.3.8) are marked N/A.

Clause 7.4 Marking of controls and instruments received an overall verdict of PASS (P). Clause 7.4.1 covers requirements for switches used to control power to ME EQUIPMENT including mains switches: on/off positions must be marked with IEC 60417-5007 and IEC 60417-5008 symbols, or indicated by adjacent indicator light, or by other unambiguous means. For switches controlling power to parts of ME EQUIPMENT, additionally IEC 60417-5264 and IEC 60417-5265 symbols may be used. Stand-by switches may use IEC 60417-5009 symbol. Bistable push buttons must use IEC 60417-5010 and show status via indicator light or other means. Momentary push buttons must use IEC 60417-5011 or show status via indicator light.
